leads.name: Wolfgangseiche (St. Wolfgang's Oak) bei Neueglofsheim
leads.reason: Two independent sources exist (Bavaria LfU state Naturdenkmal register ND-02671, and Wikidata Q2222131 'Sankt-Wolfgangs-Eiche' with a Commons photo), a rare case of a corroborated candidate this far out. But it sits about 14.6-14.7 km from Regensburg's centre, near Neueglofsheim (Gde. Thalmassing), which was not confirmed to fall inside the roughly-30-minute public transport day trip boundary in the time this pass had; access, setting (roadside, field edge, churchyard) and current condition are also unconfirmed. Worth a focused follow-up: check transit time and what the tree actually stands beside.
